# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Age:** Early twenties at death  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v3 c11 P3](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0003), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Former schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Opal is a very attractive and radiant girl with long, curly blonde hair, large vivid blue eyes, and a bright complexion. During her illness, she becomes extremely slender, pale, and frail, with a feverish flush on her cheeks and translucent hands.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c31 P3](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0003), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 c11 P3](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0003), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P4](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0004)_

## Personality

Opal is sunny, cheerful, and loves enjoying life, but she is also prone to sentimentality and emotional outbursts. She is preoccupied with male admirers and romance, though she hides a deep, fearful awareness of her declining health behind a lively facade.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 c14 P2](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0002), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011)_

## Traits

- Sunny and cheerful  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>

- Fear of dying  <sub>[v3 c14 P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007)</sub>

## Abilities

- Curing warts with an enchanted stone  <sub>[v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018)</sub>

## Goals

- To enjoy life and have many suitors before marrying  <sub>[v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>
- To pass the Entrance exams and become a teacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P33](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0033)</sub>

## History

Opal attends Brierley school and studies alongside Nell Harcourt, frequently becoming involved in the drama and games of the students. She later joins the Regent's class taught by Miss Thorne to prepare for the Entrance examinations. After passing her exams, she attends Regent's Academy in Port Marlow and qualifies as a schoolteacher. Following graduation, she teaches for a time before her health begins to fail after a bout of congestion. She contracts consumption and is forced to give up her teaching position. During her final summer in Brierley, she maintains a cheerful, flirting facade despite knowing her illness is terminal. She confides her fears of death and her true feelings for Herb Tranter to Nell shortly before passing away peacefully in her sleep.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P33](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0033), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P2](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0002), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_

## Quotes

> I’m going to get a boyfriend the moment I turn fifteen.  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005)</sub>

> I really wish those two boys had stayed away tonight, because I was hoping we could have a wonderful, long conversation, Nell, so I could share so many things with you.  <sub>[v3 c11 P53](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0053)</sub>

> And, oh, Nell... dying is not what I want. The thought of dying frightens me.  <sub>[v3 c14 P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007)</sub>

> I’ve fought so hard to live—and it isn’t any use—I have to die—and leave everything I care for.  <sub>[v3 c14 P15](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0015)</sub>

> I want to live the way other girls do. I—I desire to get married, Nell—and—and—possess tiny children.  <sub>[v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017)</sub>
